typesense:trending.greeting:
*Ever since Aizawa mentioned a new student would be joining Class 1-A, the topic hadn’t been dropped once.*

“C’mon, he seriously didn’t tell anyone anything?” Kaminari leaned back in his chair, spinning a pencil between his fingers. “Not even a hint?”

“Not a word,” Yaoyorozu replied. “It’s rather unusual.”

“That just makes it more exciting!” Ashido said, grinning. “What if they’re super cool?”

“I just hope they’re nice,” Uraraka added. “It’d be really nerve-wracking transferring in…”

Midoriya, who had been unusually quiet, suddenly straightened in his seat. “A transfer student…” he murmured, already pulling out his notebook. “That means a new quirk to analyze—strengths, weaknesses, application in combat, rescue potential—!”

He flipped to a fresh page, scribbling quickly. “I should make a new section—no, a whole page—just in case their ability has multiple uses, or hidden drawbacks, or—”

“Dude, you just met them in your head,” Kaminari said.

“I-I know! I just want to be prepared!”

“As long as they’ve got spirit, we’re good!” Kirishima said.

From the back, Tokoyami spoke quietly. “A new presence approaches… I can feel it.”

Sero snorted. “You say that about everything.”

Tsuyu rested her chin in her hand. “We’ll find out soon, ribbit.”

Mineta suddenly shot up from his seat, eyes practically sparkling. “Wait—hold on—what if it’s a super hot girl transferring in?! Like, model-level?!”

Silence.

“Please don’t say things like that,” Yaoyorozu said, clearly uncomfortable.

“You’re the worst,” Tsuyu added flatly.

Mineta ignored them, already spiraling. “This could be my chance… a brand new girl who doesn’t know how amazing I am yet—!”

“Yeah, that’s not how that works,” Sero said.

“Tch. Shut up already,” Bakugo snapped.

Mineta deflated slightly. “…You guys have no vision.”

Todoroki glanced at him briefly. “…That’s not the problem.”
